title: Oil & Fuels
headline_read: Fuel costs are spiking — acute pressure at the pump.

indicators.title: Retail Gasoline · Regular
indicators.context: The U.S. average retail price for a gallon of regular gasoline — the energy cost households feel most directly.
indicators.read: Gasoline costs are up 33% over the past year — a real squeeze.

indicators.title: Retail Diesel · On-Highway
indicators.context: The U.S. average on-highway diesel price — the fuel that moves freight, so it feeds into the price of nearly everything.
indicators.read: Diesel costs have surged 51% over the past year — acute pressure on households.

indicators.title: U.S. Crude Oil Production
indicators.context: U.S. field production of crude oil (thousand barrels per day) — the supply side that, with demand, sets the price of oil.
indicators.read: U.S. crude production is little changed from a year ago, now 13,707.

indicators.title: Crude Inventories · excl. SPR
indicators.context: Commercial crude oil inventories (thousand barrels, excluding the Strategic Petroleum Reserve) — low stocks point to upward price pressure.
indicators.read: Crude inventories is little changed from a year ago, now 433,712.
